verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਹਸਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਹਸਾਇ ਰੋਵਤ ਰੋਵਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਰੋਇ ਅਉ ਰੁਵਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: hasat hasat poochhai has has kai hasai rovat rovat poochhai roi aau ruvai kai ||

en.bdb: A laughing person merrily asks a happy and laughing person various things that can make them laugh. Similarly a crying person asks another crying person matters that causes crying.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੈਠਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟ ਜਾਇ ਚਾਲਤ ਚਲਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਦਹਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baiThe baiThe poochhai baiTh baiTh kai nikaT jai chaalat chalat poochhai dhahadhis dhai kai ||

en.bdb: A settled person will share with another settled person means of settling down. A person treading a path will ask another on the right path, things that would lead one to the right path.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗ ਪੂਛੇ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: log poochhe logaachaar bedh poochhai bedh bidh jogee bhogee jog bhog jugat jugai kai ||

en.bdb: A worldly person asks the other worldly persons various aspects of worldly affairs. One who studies Vedas would ask about Vedas from another who has the knowledge of Vedas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਸਾਕਿਓ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੩੮॥
verses.translit_en: janam maran bhram kaahoo na miTai saakio nihachal bhe gur charan samai kai ||438||

en.bdb: All the above do satiate the addiction of a person, but such prattles cannot end the birth-death cycle. Those who unite their attention in the holy feet of the Lord, only those obedient disciples of the Guru are able to end their cycle. (438)
